Their published context (quoted, not re-run; the 2025 numbers are the artefact's own `plot_cmp.py` arrays — see `neuralmc-pin/VENDOR-PIN.md`): '24 — 5 h/task limit, training 100k-2M samples/task, SMT check dominating wall-clock, 93% suite completion (194 tasks), vga the systematic failure and uart the self-reported weakness. '25 (MILP, 5 h/task) on blink specifically: their method 14/25, NMC'24-rerun 0/25, nuXmv 8/25, rIC3 6/25, ABC 5/25. House route on the 219 tasks attempted: completion 219/219 (100% per family, vga included), certificate = one piecewise-affine ranking + 2-34 Bernstein rows/task, exact Q, checked in the times above; certificate size is O(1) per family ladder (coefficient bit-length grows as log N — blink runs to N = 2^32 with no change of certificate shape).

Measurement rider: producer + check walls above measured on a GB10 (aarch64), CPython 3.12, single thread, time.perf_counter. Certificates certify the vendored pin's .sv files (neuralmc-pin/, upstream f2bd71c — the post-restructure '25 circuits; see VENDOR-PIN.md's benchmark-version caveat). Blink family invention wall (2026-07-20, session-log-bounded): spec-read + ranking design + implementation + full four-instrument battery green in ~6 min wall (~09:02-09:08 UTC; post-design implementation stamp 09:05:13 -> battery green 09:07:59 = 2 m 46 s).
